title: UK government forced to admit secret Apple encryption order
summary: The UK government has been forced to acknowledge that it issued a secret encryption order to Apple. The order’s contents remain secret; a commenter citing the Investigatory Powers Tribunal judgment said the media learned of the technical capability notice through confidential security briefings rather than a leak. The admission makes the demand’s existence public without disclosing its scope or technical requirements.
